services.desc: A hit at its premiere and beloved ever since, The Elixir of Love delights with its warmth, wit, and irresistible melody. Donizetti’s music perfectly captures this “male Cinderella” tale, from the bubbling ensembles to the tender beauty of Nemorino’s “Una furtiva lagrima,” one of opera’s most famous arias. Shy Nemorino risks all to buy an elixir of love (actually wine) from a travelling “Doctor” Dulcamara, in order to win the heart of the lovely and clever Adina. But it is only when he becomes mysteriously attractive to all the other women in town that Adina is forced to declare her feelings to Nemorino. services.desc: The Four Seasons Centre for the Performing Arts is a glass jewel in the heart of the city-conveniently located between the Financial Core and Entertainment District-with easy access to the University subway line and on-site parking. The building provides space for everything from corporate functions and AGM's, to large-scale galas and theatrical productions. The Joey and Toby Tanenbaum Opera Centre is conveniently located in downtown Toronto, near both the Gardiner Expressway and the Don Valley Parkway.
